repository.description: CarPaly — Android CarPlay receiver project with Geely Xingyue L (KX11) compatibility development.

candidate.summaryZh: v1.1.58/code 46 已在本地版本台账预留；截至 2026-10-19，GitHub 最新正式 Release 仍为 v1.1.56，尚无 v1.1.58 Tag 或 Release，本轮未构建 Release APK。本轮加入 Android 11 普通应用可用的 Wi-Fi 启动门控：缺少系统/设备所有者权限时引导用户打开官方 Wi-Fi 面板，并在无线状态变化后重试连接；新增只读 OneOS InputService 服务/权限探测和 KX11_A2 候选车型 Profile，不绑定 Binder、不映射未知按键，也不发送车辆控制命令。接口与车辆行为均未实车验证；OTA 未启用。
candidate.summaryEn: v1.1.58/code 46 is reserved in the local version ledger; as checked on 2026-10-19, GitHub's latest formal Release remains v1.1.56 and no v1.1.58 tag or Release exists. No Release APK was built in this round. This round adds an Android 11-compatible Wi-Fi startup gate: ordinary apps without system/device-owner authority are directed to the official Wi-Fi panel and connection is retried after radio state changes. It also adds a read-only OneOS InputService availability/permission probe and a candidate KX11_A2 profile; it does not bind the Binder service, map unknown keys, or send vehicle commands. OEM interfaces and vehicle behavior remain unverified in a real vehicle; OTA is disabled.
releaseNotesZh: v1.1.58/code 46 已在本地版本台账预留；截至 2026-10-19，GitHub 尚无对应 Tag 或 Release；本轮未构建 Release APK，OTA 未启用。
增加 Android 11 Wi-Fi 启动门控：普通应用权限不足时打开系统 Wi-Fi 面板，不绕过平台限制；无线状态变化后重新检查连接条件。
增加只读 OneOS InputService 服务/权限可用性探测及 KX11_A2 候选 Profile；不建立 OEM Binder 会话、不猜测方向盘键码、不发送车辆写入命令。
Wi-Fi 与 Profile 的纯逻辑测试通过；全量 Android 单元测试、Lint 和内部 Debug assemble 本轮已运行。所有真实 OEM、CarPlay、音频、显示、方向盘和车辆数据功能仍需目标车辆验证。
releaseNotesEn: v1.1.58/code 46 is reserved in the local version ledger; as checked on 2026-10-19, no corresponding GitHub tag or Release exists. No Release APK was built in this round, and OTA remains disabled.

Adds an Android 11 Wi-Fi startup gate: ordinary apps lacking platform authority are directed to the system Wi-Fi panel; no platform restriction is bypassed, and connection readiness is rechecked after radio state changes.
Adds read-only OneOS InputService availability/permission discovery and a candidate KX11_A2 profile; it does not bind an OEM Binder service, guess steering key codes, or issue vehicle writes.

Pure Wi-Fi/profile tests passed; the full Android unit-test, Lint, and internal Debug assemble CI command ran in this round. Real-vehicle CarPlay, OEM, audio, display, steering-wheel, and vehicle-data behavior remains unverified.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈连接正常；测试 APK 版本、车型配置及有线/无线模式未记录，维护者未独立复现。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported a normal connection; APK version, vehicle trim, and wired/wireless mode were not recorded and have not been independently reproduced.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 历史用户反馈称音乐播放约一秒后自动暂停，唤醒 Siri 时可播放；V1.1.54 日志未复现该现象，根因未知，本轮未实车复测。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: Historical user feedback reported that music paused after about one second but played while Siri was active. The V1.1.54 logs did not reproduce this; the cause is unknown and no vehicle retest occurred in this round.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈导航提示音无声；根因及修复状态尚未由本轮新实车复测确认。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported silent navigation prompts; the root cause and any fix have not been confirmed by a new vehicle retest.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈可听见 Siri 且 Siri 能听见用户；未独立复现。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported hearing Siri and being heard by Siri; not independently reproduced.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈按键有响应；具体按键与映射未记录，未独立复现。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported responsive keys; individual keys and mappings were not recorded and have not been independently reproduced.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈仍遮挡 CarPlay 画面。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported that the OEM status bar still overlaps the CarPlay view.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 没有可核实的实车接口调用或验收证据。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: No verifiable in-vehicle interface call or acceptance evidence is available.
